fusions.name: Becalming Cloud
fusions.desc: Breathes a drifting cloud of strands in a cone out to 5 tiles, which deals 11 damage to everything caught in it, stuns each for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Venom
fusions.desc: A slow bite deals 25 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Drift and Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Afterward, Rest
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, healing you receive rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
